audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for temple prediction, Olivet discourse, birth-pains, persecution, abomination/desolation, false messiahs, cosmic signs, Son of Humanity, fig tree, this generation, unknown day/hour, Noah, watchfulness, faithful servant.

verses.restored: Jesus went out from the temple and was going away, and his disciples came to point out the temple buildings to him.

familiar.text: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.

verses.restored: He answered them, Do you not see all these things? Amen, I say to you: not one stone will be left here on another that will not be thrown down.

familiar.text: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

verses.restored: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came privately, saying, Tell us, when will these things be, and what is the sign of your arrival/presence and of the completion of the age?

familiar.text: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

verses.restored: Jesus answered, See that no one leads you astray.

familiar.text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.

verses.restored: For many will come in my name, saying, I am the Messiah, and they will lead many astray.

familiar.text: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

verses.restored: You will hear of wars and reports of wars. See that you are not troubled, for it must happen, but the end is not yet.

familiar.text: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

verses.restored: Nation will rise against nation, and reign against reign, and there will be famines and earthquakes in various places.

familiar.text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.

verses.restored: All these are the beginning of birth-pains.

familiar.text: All these are the beginning of sorrows.

verses.restored: Then they will hand you over to pressure and kill you, and you will be hated by all nations because of my name.

familiar.text: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.

verses.restored: Then many will stumble, hand one another over, and hate one another.

familiar.text: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.

verses.restored: Many false prophets will arise and lead many astray.

familiar.text: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.

verses.restored: Because lawlessness increases, the love of the many will grow cold.

familiar.text: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.

verses.restored: But the one enduring to the end will be saved.

familiar.text: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

verses.restored: This good message of the reign will be proclaimed in the whole inhabited world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.

familiar.text: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.

verses.restored: Therefore when you see the abomination of desolation spoken of through Daniel the prophet standing in the holy place, let the reader understand,

familiar.text: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)

verses.restored: then those in Judea must flee to the mountains.

familiar.text: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:

verses.restored: The one on the roof must not go down to take things from the house,

familiar.text: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:

verses.restored: and the one in the field must not turn back to take the cloak.

familiar.text: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.

verses.restored: Woe to those carrying in the womb and nursing infants in those days.

familiar.text: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

verses.restored: Pray that your flight may not happen in winter or on a Sabbath.

familiar.text: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:

verses.restored: For then there will be great pressure such as has not happened from the beginning of the world until now, nor ever will happen.

familiar.text: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

verses.restored: Unless those days were shortened, no flesh would be saved; but because of the chosen, those days will be shortened.

familiar.text: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.

verses.restored: Then if anyone says to you, Look, here is the Messiah, or, Here, do not trust it.

familiar.text: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.

verses.restored: For false messiahs and false prophets will arise and give great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen.

familiar.text: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.

verses.restored: Look, I have told you beforehand.

familiar.text: Behold, I have told you before.

verses.restored: Therefore if they say to you, Look, he is in the wilderness, do not go out; Look, in the inner rooms, do not trust it.

familiar.text: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.

verses.restored: For just as lightning comes out from east and shines to west, so will be the arrival/presence of the Son of Humanity.

familiar.text: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

verses.restored: Wherever the corpse is, there the vultures/eagles will be gathered.

familiar.text: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

verses.restored: Immediately after the pressure of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

familiar.text: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

verses.restored: Then the sign of the Son of Humanity will appear in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn; they will see the Son of Humanity coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

familiar.text: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

verses.restored: He will send his messengers with a great trumpet, and they will gather his chosen from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.

familiar.text: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

verses.restored: From the fig tree learn the parable: when its branch becomes tender and puts out leaves, you know summer is near.

familiar.text: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:

verses.restored: So also, when you see all these things, know that it is near, at the doors.

familiar.text: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

verses.restored: Amen, I say to you: this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things happen.

familiar.text: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.

verses.restored: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will certainly not pass away.

familiar.text: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

verses.restored: Concerning that day and hour, no one knows, not the messengers of the heavens nor the Son, but the Father alone.

familiar.text: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

verses.restored: As the days of Noah were, so will be the arrival/presence of the Son of Humanity.

familiar.text: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

verses.restored: For as in those days before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day Noah entered the ark,

familiar.text: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,

verses.restored: and they did not know until the flood came and took all away, so also will be the arrival/presence of the Son of Humanity.

familiar.text: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

verses.restored: Then two will be in the field; one is taken and one is left.

familiar.text: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

verses.restored: Two women will be grinding at the mill; one is taken and one is left.

familiar.text: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

verses.restored: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord comes.

familiar.text: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.

verses.restored: Know this: if the householder had known in what watch the thief comes, he would have kept watch and not allowed his house to be broken into.

familiar.text: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.

verses.restored: Because of this, you also be ready, for the Son of Humanity comes at an hour you do not think.

familiar.text: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

verses.restored: Who then is the faithful and wise servant whom the lord appointed over his household to give them food in season?

familiar.text: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?

verses.restored: Blessed/flourishing is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

familiar.text: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

verses.restored: Amen, I say to you: he will appoint him over all his possessions.

familiar.text: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.

verses.restored: But if that harmful servant says in his heart, My lord delays,

familiar.text: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

verses.restored: and begins to strike his fellow servants and eats and drinks with drunkards,

familiar.text: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;

verses.restored: the lord of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not know,

familiar.text: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,

verses.restored: and will cut him off and place his portion with the hypocrites; there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.

familiar.text: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
